recorded_by: hand-assembled; the streamed stdout survived, the JSON did not
how_the_failure_was_observed: Not by the probe. A CUDA or host out-of-memory at this size kills the kernel rather than raising, so the except clause never ran and the file was never written. The three surviving rows come from the streamed stdout and the kill from the runtime log. The probe now writes each row as it is measured, so the next climb records its own last step.
